snippet.title: LISA - Always Lalisa (Official Trailer)
snippet.description:
ALWAYS LALISA
In Cinemas & IMAX Worldwide, October 12
Ticket at https://alwayslalisa.com

Always Lalisa is a feature-length documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from Blackpink, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. As the group pauses activities, LISA embarks on the first true chapter of her solo career, confronting the question of who she is beyond Blackpink.

The film follows LISA as she writes, records, and releases her debut solo album, Alter Ego, makes her acting debut in the third season of The White Lotus, and prepares for her first major solo performance at the 2025 Coachella Music Festival. Born and raised in Thailand, LISA left home at fourteen to train in South Korea's demanding K-pop system, ultimately rising to global superstardom. But forging her own path, particularly in the Western music market, brings new pressures, relentless scrutiny, and the challenge of redefining herself on her own terms.

Intimate, emotional, and revealing, Always Lalisa captures an artist at a crossroads, documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define not only her next chapter, but the woman and artist she wants to become.

Born and raised in Thailand, LISA left home at fourteen to train in South Korea's demanding K-pop system, ultimately rising to global superstardom. Intimate, emotional, and revealing, Always Lalisa captures an artist at a crossroads, documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define not only her next chapter, but the woman and artist she wants to become.

snippet.title: Rubius REACCIONA al REMAKE de ZELDA Ocarina of Time
snippet.description:
Rubius REACCIONA al TRAILER del NUEVO ZELDA OCARINA OF TIME

Rubius reacciona al trailer de Zelda Ocarina of Time. Mira las primeras impresiones sobre el regreso de Link y el anuncio del nuevo restaurante temático.

En este video, analizamos los fragmentos más destacados del reciente Nintendo Direct. Repasamos la historia de Link, Zelda y Ganondorf, mientras comentamos el estilo visual y las secuencias de juego que han sorprendido a toda la comunidad. Es el análisis perfecto para quienes siguen de cerca las novedades de esta legendaria franquicia.

Además de la jugabilidad, comentamos el anuncio oficial de la inauguración de El Super Family Restaurant en otoño de 2026, un lugar donde los fans podrán ver a Link en persona. A lo largo de esta trailer reacción, desglosamos cada detalle revelado sobre el futuro de la saga y compartimos nuestras expectativas ante lo que está por venir en el universo de Zelda Ocarina of Time.
